action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tyrannosaurus makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail. It can't make both attacks against the same target.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}, and the tyrannosaurus can't bite another target.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

This enormous predator terrorizes all other creatures in its territory. Despite its size and weight, a tyrannosaurus is a swift runner. It chases anything it thinks it can eat, and there are few creatures it won't try to devour whole. While prowling for substantial prey, a tyrannosaurus subsists on carrion, and on any smaller creatures that try to dart in to steal its meal.

entries.name: Dinosaurs
entries: Dinosaurs, or behemoths, are among the oldest reptiles in the world. Predatory dinosaurs are savage, territorial hunters. Herbivorous dinosaurs are less aggressive, but they might attack to defend their young, or if startled or harassed.

Dinosaurs come in many sizes and shapes. Larger varieties often have drab coloration, while smaller dinosaurs have colorful markings akin to birds. Dinosaurs roam rugged and isolated areas that humanoids seldom visit, including remote mountain valleys, inaccessible plateaus, tropical islands, and deep fens.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tyrannosaurus makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}33 ({@damage 4d12 + 7}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 17}). While {@condition Grappled|SRD52}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition and can't be targeted by the tyrannosaurus's Tail.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.
